source.paraphrase: In runes mode a component notifies its parent through a callback prop. createEventDispatcher is the legacy event API.

invariants.why: A dispatcher event needs a forwarding listener at every level, while a callback prop is a typed function the parent passes down directly.
invariants.fixHint: Declare the callback in $props (let { onsave } = $props()) and call it instead of dispatching.
invariants.avoid: Importing the dispatcher from svelte/legacy is the same legacy call and is still flagged. Typing the dispatcher with a generic does not change the call shape.

source.paraphrase: The svelte/legacy module keeps old components running. New runes code imports from svelte instead.

invariants.why: A legacy import pulls the compatibility layer into new code, so the next migration has to untangle both APIs from the same module.
invariants.fixHint: Import from svelte (untrack, tick) or svelte/store. Isolate remaining legacy usage in one adapter module.
invariants.avoid: A dynamic import or a require of the same path is still the compatibility layer. A comment that mentions the path is not an import and is ignored.

source.paraphrase: tick settles after pending state changes apply. An un-awaited tick lets later lines run before the update landed.

invariants.why: Code after a floating tick reads the DOM before the state change applied, so measurements and focus land on the previous render.
invariants.fixHint: Await the tick, or return it when the caller waits. Chain .then only on an awaited or returned tick.
invariants.avoid: A branch does not settle the promise: tick on one arm still floats when the arm runs. Awaiting the .then chain settles it and is ignored.
